merchandise_categories.name: Foods and Sundries
merchandise_categories.role_in_flywheel: High-frequency grocery and household staples driver; accounts for over two-fifths of merchandise sales and anchors regular member shopping trips.

merchandise_categories.name: Non-Foods
merchandise_categories.role_in_flywheel: Rotating seasonal, electronics, appliance, and home goods selection; drives higher average basket sizes while maintaining strict inventory turnover discipline.

merchandise_categories.name: Fresh Foods
merchandise_categories.role_in_flywheel: Highest 2-year sales growth (+15.49%) among core warehouse departments; drives frequent weekly member visits and rapid inventory turnover across bakery, meat, produce, and deli.

merchandise_categories.name: Warehouse Ancillary and Other Businesses
merchandise_categories.role_in_flywheel: Traffic-driving member services (discount gasoline across 719 stations, pharmacy, optical, food court, hearing aid, e-commerce, and Costco Travel) operated at near break-even margins to reinforce membership renewal.
